content.short: Anton Tools is an open-source TON indexer and explorer stack for blocks, transactions, accounts, and messages.
content.description: Anton Tools, shown publicly as tonindexer, indexes data from the TON blockchain. Its site exposes explorer views for blocks, transactions, accounts, messages, and interface or operation statistics, with API and GitHub links for developers. It belongs in infrastructure because it makes TON chain data easier to query and inspect. tonindexer - The project to index data from TON blockchain. That shows up in features such as anton explorer, accounts by interfaces type, messages by operation type, and last blocks.
